headline: GTA VI hacker Arion Kurtaj pleads guilty to Rockstar breach
summary: Arion Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group, pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and leaking Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage in 2022. He also hacked other companies, including BT/EE. Kurtaj, now 21, was earlier deemed fit to stand trial after the breach.

claims.statement: Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to the Rockstar Games hack and other hacks he carried out as a teenager.

sources.quote: 21-year-old Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to the Rockstar Games hack and others he carried out when he was a teenager.

claims.statement: Kurtaj was deemed fit to stand trial earlier this year after breaching Rockstar's systems in 2022.

sources.quote: Arion Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group who leaked 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI in 2022 and hacked other big companies, pleaded guilty on Monday, according to the UK's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS).
